roles/akasha_collector/templates/akasha-:
#!/bin/sh
# Same lock and database as akasha-collector.service. Never a second shipper.
set -eu
export AKASHA_URL="{{ akasha_collector_url }}"
export AKASHA_TOKEN_HELPER="${AKASHA_TOKEN_HELPER:-{{ akasha_collector_token_helper }}}"
export AKASHA_STATE_FILE="{{ fleet_home }}/.local/state/chaldea/events/collector.db"
export AKASHA_TIMER_SPOOL="{{ fleet_home }}/.local/state/chaldea/timer-spool"
export AKASHA_SPOOL="${AKASHA_SPOOL:-{{ fleet_home }}/.local/share/toolfeedback}"
unset FEED_TOKEN FEED_KEY_FILE FEED_CONFIG
exec /usr/bin/flock --nonblock "{{ fleet_home }}/.local/state/chaldea/events/collector.lock" "{{ akasha_collector_node }}" "{{ akasha_collector_script }}" "$@"
